data.body: THIRD HARM (concrete, from live session diagnosis) — strengthens the fix toward removing base=main: the umbrella draft PR (base=main, head=session) makes check-staged-head (a required check scoped 'on: pull_request: branches:[main]') RUN on the shared session HEAD commit. check-staged-head enforces 'only staged-* heads may target main'; the umbrella's head is the session worktree branch (not staged-*), so it HARD-FAILS. GitHub attaches that failing check-run to the commit SHA, and because PR1 (session->staged, e.g. #558) shares the same head SHA, the failing status CONTAMINATES PR1 -> merge-to-main treats it as a terminal required-check failure and refuses to advance. So the umbrella PR being base=main is not merely confusing the resume fallback — it ACTIVELY BREAKS promotion via shared-commit status contamination. IMPLICATION: filtering the resume open-PR fallback to ignore the umbrella (option i) is INSUFFICIENT; the contamination happens independent of resume. The 1f5f fix must prevent the umbrella from being base=main (option ii — relocate the GitHubPRDefenseStore substrate / stop opening a base=main draft), OR scope check-staged-head to the actual promotion PR. This is now the strongest evidence that the umbrella PR is the linchpin of the whole cascade.
